notes:
fix: suppress console on restart, fix first-install status, branded installer

- Replace app.restart() with CREATE_NO_WINDOW spawn so the relaunched
  binary never flashes a console window, even before Windows reads the
  PE subsystem flag from the new binary
- Add windows_subsystem = windows to main.rs for all release builds
- Add CREATE_NO_WINDOW to Java child process to prevent MC terminal
- Separate dev/release data dirs via cfg!(debug_assertions)
- Persist quick-join server slots to file instead of localStorage
- Branded NSIS installer images (header + sidebar BMPs)
- Show NOT INSTALLED vs UPDATE AVAILABLE for client mods
- Release notes generation in workflow
